scope: All 22 source-name families sampled at first/middle/last; all 30 cross-family candidate pairs visually inspected. Not an expert label audit.
algorithm: 300x250 thumbnail; aHash64 <= 8 or AC-only pHash63 <= 12; rotations 0/90/180/270 and reflection. pHash input is the quality-80 review JPEG.
base_group_rule: Preserve the entire first original-name numeric prefix; unknown physical identity is not inferred from filenames.

decisions.reason: Different internal trace topology and terminal positions despite similar outer shape.
Different pad counts, branching and central routing; hash false positive.
Dense chip-pad array versus sparse broad loops; different visible layouts.
Different central branching and terminal organization.
Same or sufficiently related layout structures to keep both source families in one split; conservative grouping, not a claim of identical physical boards.
Different connector and central routing topology.
